'''Jason Gillman March 2002 Dittmer tournament report (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Jason Gillman]] posted on DeckTech on 20 March 2002 about [[March 2002 Dittmer tournament]].<ref name="tr-d3516">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/ Dittmer MO standings (DeckTech report d3516; listed in the archive index)], DeckTech (Jason "3RD EYE" Gillman, 20 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Its posted title is not shown on this wiki (see the note on this copy). Jason Gillman posted the standings of a 12-player tournament in Dittmer, Missouri, which he won ahead of Tony Nowicki and Justin Gillman.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Jason Gillman]] (byline: Jason "3RD EYE" Gillman)
* '''Published:''' 20 March 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Dittmer MO standings'' (neutral title; the posted title is not shown)
* '''Event:''' [[March 2002 Dittmer tournament]]
* '''Event date:''' March 2002
* '''Site:''' Dittmer, Missouri
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Finish:''' 1st

== Note on this copy ==

Parts of this report are not reproduced on this wiki: the posted title, a private street address, is not shown; the standings list itself is complete; the archive link points to the DeckTech report index because the report's own address contains the street address. Each removed passage is marked in the text below. Everything else is verbatim; the full original is in the DeckTech archive (see Sources).
